items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My mother realized that she was going to have a baby and went as fast as she could to Dr. Neff on [ ] a half a block away, and knocked on the door.

ctx.x: . . . in Concord. Were you born at home? At a hospital?

I was born at home. My mother realized that she was going to have a baby and went as fast as she could to Dr. Neff on [ ] a half a block away, and knocked on the door. I guess it was about four in the morning. Dr. Neff came to the door and said, “Bessie, go home and get in bed, and I’ll be right there.” So she went home, got in bed.
She remembers the doctor taking his scalpel and just ripping off her nightgown, and the baby was born.
